intro.text: Known as the Voidbringer, the ruler of Odium's empire on Ashyn, whose war with Makibak led to the planet's ruin.

items.text: Zoral led Odium's empire on Ashyn, then called Alaswha, whose people Odium gave Surges. The empire swallowed city-states or forced their kings, such as Jezrien, to pledge allegiance. Makibak and his nephew Nale opposed him. Zoral died when the empire collapsed as Ashyn was destroyed, and Jezrien succeeded him and led humanity to Roshar.
